Sometimes {npc:Noodles}, {npc:King Tibianus}' dog, runs away from the castle and wanders all over the Thais peninsula. Ask the king for a leash, find Noodles, use the leash on him and go back to the king to receive experience, gold (or, if you are lucky, a {item:Fan Doll of Queen Eloise}) and the achievement Dog Sitter.
